title: Las Vegas trip planner: executive summary
bullets: Trip window: Feb 15 to Mar 23, 2027. Preferred: Mon Feb 15 to Thu Feb 18 (3 nights). Costs are shown on a 7-night basis (Feb 15 to 22) as the brief asks. You need to choose the length (see Questions Q1).
Feb 15, 2027 is Presidents' Day (Washington's Birthday), a federal holiday per OPM. Effect on prices not verified.

MICHELIN Las Vegas (official 2026 Southwest selection): 24 restaurants: 4 starred (Restaurant de Joël Robuchon 2 stars; é by José Andrés, Guy Savoy Las Vegas and L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon 1 star each), 3 Bib Gourmand, 17 Recommended. Addresses come from the official release.

Michelin clusters: the Strip (MGM Grand, The Cosmopolitan, Caesars, The Venetian, Bellagio, ARIA, Wynn, Resorts World), Chinatown on Spring Mountain Road (6 listings), and Downtown and Off-Strip (a few listings).

Michelin clusters: the Strip (MGM Grand, The Cosmopolitan, Caesars, The Venetian, Bellagio, ARIA, Wynn, Resorts World, plus Gold Coast Off-Strip), Chinatown on Spring Mountain Road (5 listings by LVCVA label, plus Lamaii on Spring Mountain Rd. labelled Off-Strip), Downtown (2) and other Off-Strip listings.

Hotel prices: NO verified 7-night totals were found for these dates. Price cells are blank and flagged. Only one room type is confirmed from an official page: Caesars Palace Colosseum Strip View Room with 2 queens.
Private bathroom: not confirmed for any hotel.

Activities with verified hours and fees: Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon (timed-entry reservation required in February), Valley of Fire State Park, The Neon Museum. Drive or transit times from hotels are not verified.
Transit: no subway appears on official transit sites. RTC bus and the Las Vegas Monorail (7 Strip stations) are the official options. The brief's subway requirement needs your confirmation.
Cheapest time to book: NOT verified. Only current promotions (Caesars, Wynn, Venetian) and general booking windows (MICHELIN restaurants, 30 to 60 days; é up to three months) are verified.

Verification status: most cells outside the verified items are marked Unverified. Every published row has at least one official-source link. The Flagged for Review page lists all irregularities and unverified items for your review.
